title: verify_f4_indicator_api_with_valid_symbol
description: Test the GET /api/indicators/f4 endpoint with a valid symbol like BTCUSDT to ensure it returns a 200 status and the payload contains f4Series, f4Fibo, aiScore, whaleSignal, and regimePrediction.

title: verify_f4_indicator_api_with_invalid_symbol
description: Test the GET /api/indicators/f4 endpoint with an invalid symbol to verify the API returns a 400 status with an appropriate validation error message.

title: verify_market_scan_api_with_valid_type
description: Test the GET /api/market/scan endpoint with valid types such as gainers, losers, and squeezes to ensure it returns a 200 status with the expected market scan data.

title: verify_market_scan_api_when_external_scanner_fails
description: Test the GET /api/market/scan endpoint when the external TradingView scanner API fails or cache is empty to verify the API returns a 503 status with a 'scanner unavailable' message.

title: verify_matrix_portfolio_ui_loads_with_valid_data
description: Test loading the /matrix-portfolio dashboard to ensure it requests the F4 Indicator API and displays portfolio health, AI signals, and predicted targets correctly when the API returns valid data.

title: verify_matrix_portfolio_ui_handles_api_failure
description: Test loading the /matrix-portfolio dashboard when the F4 Indicator API returns a 500 error or times out to verify the UI displays 'Signal unavailable' and shows last-known snapshot or placeholder.

title: verify_command_deck_kill_switch_enable_success
description: Test enabling the kill switch from the /command-deck UI to ensure the backend updates the system state, returns 200, and the dashboard shows 'Trading paused - Kill Switch ON'.

title: verify_command_deck_kill_switch_enable_failure
description: Test enabling the kill switch from the /command-deck UI when the backend returns a 403 or network error to verify the UI shows 'Failed to change system state' and retains the previous setting.

title: verify_price_prediction_widget_with_high_confidence
description: Test the /price-prediction widget by entering a valid symbol like ETHUSDT and verifying that the API returns predictedTargets and confidence, which are displayed correctly in the widget.

title: verify_price_prediction_widget_with_low_confidence
description: Test the /price-prediction widget when the prediction model returns low confidence or an error to verify the widget shows a 'Low confidence' advisory and recommends waiting or manual review.
